label.zh: 舰队进入星际绑架者的系统
label.en: A fleet enters the Ransomeers' system

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:983 on_entering_system_fleet → anomaly.3095 (events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2561): the system has star flag ransomeer_system and the owner has captive_rescue (set by anomaly.3094).

label.zh: 别人先击毁了绑架者基地（有接触，约50%）
label.en: Someone else destroys the Ransomeer base first (with contact, about 50%)

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1577 on_fleet_destroyed_victim → anomaly.3097 (hidden, events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2612): the victim is a faction fleet with ransomeer_base_flag and the destroyer is an ordinary country you have contact with; random 50/50 between anomaly.3098 and anomaly.3099.

label.zh: 别人先击毁了绑架者基地（有接触，约50%）
label.en: Someone else destroys the Ransomeer base first (with contact, about 50%)

bridges.evidence: Same hook, the other half of the 50/50 random_list (events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2636-2660).

label.zh: 基地被没有接触的势力击毁
label.en: The base is destroyed by someone you have no contact with

bridges.evidence: events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2664-2672: anomaly.3097 fires anomaly.3100 when the destroyer is not an ordinary country or you have no established contact.

label.en: You destroy the Ransomeer base yourself

bridges.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1630 on_fleet_destroyed_perp → anomaly.3101 (events/anomaly_events_2.txt:2768): the owner has captive_rescue, the relation flag ransomeer_relation toward the destroyed country, and the destroyed fleet has ransomeer_base_flag.

label.zh: 他人击毁基地：俘虏死或生（各50%）
label.en: Base destroyed by another: captives die or live (50% each)

note.zh: 仅当击毁者是你有接触的普通国家；否则只有 3100。
note.en: Only when the destroyer is an ordinary country you have contact with; otherwise only 3100.

note.zh: 俘虏死亡，对击毁者好感度下降，链结束。
note.en: The captives are dead; opinion of the destroyer drops; the chain ends.

note.zh: 俘虏获救，对击毁者好感度上升，链结束。
note.en: The captives are saved; opinion of the destroyer rises; the chain ends.

note.zh: 无接触的势力击毁基地，链结束。
note.en: A power you have no contact with destroyed the base; the chain ends.

note.zh: 俘虏死于大火：获得影响力加成，并带有“失败的救星”修正，持续约五年。
note.en: The captives die in the fire: an influence bonus with the Failed Savior modifier for about five years.

note.zh: 俘虏获救：较大影响力加成与“救世主”修正（3600天）。
note.en: The captives are saved: a larger influence bonus and the 'savior' modifier (3600 days).
